Three comments

Purfy’s

Someone asked for this to be posted, although it’s not a tune I’d choose to play myself, I just happened to have a transcription from Aberdeen flute-player Malcolm Reavell. Composed by Brian Finnegan, and recorded on his first solo CD.

↳ Posted by Kenny on January 20th, 2007.
